card.name: Mixed function points mid-sentence
card.fires_on: Mostly the comma after 'unknown' in the opioid addiction warning ('Although the risk of addiction in any individual is unknown,'). It also fires on scattered small words and punctuation in news and essay prose.

modes.label: Opioid warning comma
modes.description: The comma ending the clause 'Although the risk of addiction in any individual is unknown' in opioid labels.
modes.example: Although the risk of addiction in any individual is unknown<<,>> it can occur in patients appropriately prescribed Ox

modes.label: Scattered prose points
modes.description: Small words or punctuation in essay and news text, such as 'the' after 'For' or a period closing a quoted statement.
